commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
BRANCH=work/photomap-straighten-20260912
BASE=1b8f52c78b4be3b70ba05f09326dbc49d491a1cc
SHA=eca60d3932ef1ab3ad2f99957a4271eab3e8c77b
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git switch --detach "$SHA"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA"
git diff --check "$BASE" "$SHA"
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-memory-review-122-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV"' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pytest -q backend/app/tests/services/test_admin_memory_review_transactions.py backend/app/tests/api/memories/test_admin_memory_moderation.py backend/app/tests/services/test_rejected_original_retention_state.py
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
printf 'verified_sha=%s\n' "$SHA"
trap - EXIT
rm -rf "$VENV"
